file.conventions: Root CLAUDE.md is binding. No std:: containers; every .cpp starts with #include "Zenith.h"; tabs; braces on new lines; Zenith_Assert is the real assert (ZENITH_ASSERT is an empty marker). Never run Sharpmake in a worktree.
cleanup: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Get-Process zenithmon,combat,devilsplayground -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0"

Zenithmon.conventions: Games/Zenithmon/CLAUDE.md + Docs/AgentBriefing.md are binding. ZM_ prefix. NEVER create a branch, PR, or worktree (ZM-D-031).

Engine.conventions: Engine work moves EVERY game's pinned unit count if it adds a backend-neutral engine unit - the ticket's Definition of Done must list every pinned site.

DevilsPlayground.conventions: Games/DevilsPlayground/Docs are binding; no paid/external services.

ScriptTest.conventions: Games/ScriptTest/CLAUDE.md is binding. ST_ prefix. ZERO gameplay C++: the game defines no game ECS component and no game graph-node implementation -- every behaviour is an engine-owned node wired by a BuildGraph_ST_* builder in ScriptTest.cpp. ST_NoGameExtensionsContract enforces that mechanically; adding either is a redesign, not a fix. Every string two things must agree on lives once in ScriptTest_Graphs.h.
